rationale: The user identified approval as mandatory and reported that it stalled the workflow. Inspection established only the blocked state. The no-file-change boundary and explicit request for a replacement made Redesign appropriate. The proposal preserves the approval gate, gives both actors one record with a visible owner, and requires reconciliation before retrying an uncertain release. Concrete verification scenarios cover duplicate effects, withdrawal racing with approval, accessible resumption, and preservation of unrelated records. The approver, protected action, and storage limits remain open. The recorded commands were read-only, and the fixture snapshots match.
